coverage: A real FTS unseen-record bridge uses one scoring pass, literal source terms and one bounded expansion; original evidence reads and seed-text byte-span trace are checked.
Current/historical scope and stale-source fences prevent ineligible scoring/output; mixed Chinese/code question fallback works without an index. Direct lookup syntax is preserved.
Missing/duplicate/foreign IDs, NaN/infinite/out-of-range scores, absent model identity and thrown scorer exceptions produce one explicit lexical fallback without retries.
Failed second scoring preserves completed first-stage inputs/scores in the report and never returns unscored expanded evidence as a completed result.
Question/input/context caps and pre/post-callback cancellation/deadline are explicit; whole evidence references remain intact. Source correction clears final context.

TypeSafe synthetic tests check pinned official origin, no redirects/environment proxies, named typed payloads, finite probabilities, model/usage bounds, attempt/judgment/token admission, unknown reservations, 499 no-retry, bounded 429 retry and auth latch.
The loopback adapter exercises actual HTTP success, 65536-byte response overflow, timeout and cancellation with synthetic credentials; error bodies and key-bearing diagnostics never enter results.
Literal dotenv parsing ignores unrelated values and rejects duplicate, interpolated and missing key entries. Account discovery copies only bounded model identity/date fields.

The actual command fixture retains prepared/completed original receipts, narrows explicit source scope, preserves historical classification and refuses an existing output. It sends no provider request.
limitations: No TypeSafe scoring POST, frozen 20-question A/B/C pilot, evidence-recall/all-evidence measurement, supported 4B answer/citation study, scorer cold/warm p50/p95, server RAM/VRAM or production rollout was performed. Local fixture success is reliability evidence only.

Direct official API returned HTTP 451 before usable account discovery; unauthenticated diagnostics confirm explicit region unavailability. Key validity, account balance and actual available scorer revision are unverified. Supported access is an operation-scoped owner dependency, not a whole-Goal pause.

One serial foreground client owns in-process batch budgets. Prepared/per-arm receipts prevent automatic restart into an existing output; no automatic paid resume is implemented. Direct research-command SIGKILL recovery was not independently tested; it reuses the separately process-crash-tested store.

Token reservations use the advertised default 64k provider request context, conservatively interpreted as 65536, with no long-context header. Charges are estimates/provider-reported usage rather than billing proof; unknown outcomes retain their reserve and out-of-range usage disables scoring.

The research baseline uses fixed question_terms_v1 policy for all arms. Existing direct FTS callers keep their syntax. Unicode word segmentation is absent; mixed Chinese/code lookup tests do not establish arbitrary Chinese retrieval quality.

Host callback cancellation and I/O are cooperative. Arbitrary blocking callbacks, storage power loss, Windows runtime, full-corpus RAM, hardware/MCU execution and forensic erasure are not qualified. Portable C is unchanged; core-only verification was not repeated.
The prior blank-after-reload browser failure remains unresolved historical evidence. A clean current canonical pass does not establish a product fix.

Expiry-intent metadata/recap-head retention, generic claim/conclusion validators, direct recap admission, broader forgetting/lifecycle/handoffs and embedded ports remain open. No model substitution, production restart, region bypass or Panda publication.
